title: Hacker News post alleges Jensen Huang has resigned as NVIDIA CEO
summary: A Hacker News submission posted on 12 November 2026 links to reports alleging that Jensen Huang has stepped down as NVIDIA&\#x27;s CEO, including a Reuters live page describing a board meeting over "affair reports" and a New York Times live page headlined "Nvidia: Jensen Huang resigns." The submission itself is link-only: no NVIDIA announcement text, board vote, successor name, or effective date is included, and the cited URLs are future-dated, so the resignation could not be verified from the supplied material. The AP News link&\#x27;s URL slug references China and Singapore, hinting at the export-control angle commenters focused on, but the AP article body was not provided. Readers should treat the claim as an unconfirmed report circulating on Hacker News rather than an established fact.
